prompt: Pick up where this story left off: Detective Schroeder sits alone in his cell, determined to prove he didn’t kill his daughter. As he uncovers evidence of a conspiracy led by Commissioner Gaider and his own partner, he must form an uneasy alliance with a sympathetic jail guard and hack into police records to find the truth. Include at least three flashback scenes to Stephanie’s last day, a daring break-in to retrieve hidden CCTV footage, and a tense courtroom finale. The finished story should run 12,000-15,000 words.
